kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نسحنكك (form XIV)
# نَسْحَنْكِكُ (nasḥankiku) /nas.ħan.ki.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْحَنْكَكَ (isḥankaka)
# نَسْحَنْكِكَ (nasḥankika) /nas.ħan.ki.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْحَنْكَكَ (isḥankaka)
# نَسْحَنْكِكْ (nasḥankik) /nas.ħan.kik/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْحَنْكَكَ (isḥankaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
